Based on the screenshot provided, here is a detailed description of the members portal page:

### 1. Page Layout (Top to Bottom)
*   **Header Area:** At the very top, there is a browser address bar showing the URL `kozycare.ng/portal`. Below that, a "Back to home" link is visible on the left. The main header features the text **"WELCOME BACK"** in small gold letters, followed by the large bold title **"Testerman Membership2"** and the subtext `cad4a25vk4@woosh.dpdns.org`. On the right side of this header are two buttons: **"Sign out"** and a yellow **"Book pickup"** button.
*   **Status Cards:** Immediately below the header are three white rectangular cards arranged horizontally:
    *   **ACTIVE** (with a cube icon) - showing the number **0**.
    *   **PAST** (with a document icon) - showing the number **0**.
    *   **GUARANTEE** (with a sparkle icon) - showing the number **0**.
*   **Navigation Tabs:** Below the status cards is a row of three navigation links/tabs: **"Active (0)"**, **"History (0)"**, and a dark blue button labeled **"Membership"** (which appears to be the currently active/selected tab).
*   **Payment Banner Position:** The payment banner is positioned **below** these navigation tabs. It occupies the upper portion of the main content area for the "Membership" tab.

### 2. Exact Text Quotes
*   **Membership Status/Confirmation:**
    *   "**WELCOME BACK**"
    *   "**Testerman Membership2**"
    *   "**We received your membership — complete your first payment below and your month starts the moment it is confirmed...**"
*   **Amounts:**
    *   "**₦50,000 /month**"
*   **Payment Instructions & Status:**
    *   "**Awaiting payment verification**" (inside a white pill-shaped badge).
    *   "...**(card payments verify themselves instantly; transfers take a human glance).**"
*   **Plan Name:**
    *   "**✦ KOZY CIRCLE · THE HOUSEHOLD**"

### 3. Payment Section Position
*   **Position:** The payment section is located in the **middle-to-lower part** of the visible page. It is definitely **not at the top**.
*   **Content Above It:** There is a significant amount of content above the payment section, including:
    1.  The browser chrome and "Back to home" link.
    2.  The entire welcome header (Welcome back, name, sign out/book pickup buttons).
    3.  The three summary cards (Active, Past, Guarantee).
    4.  The sub-navigation tabs (Active, History, Membership).
    
    The payment banner itself starts roughly halfway down the screen, below the "Membership" tab button. Below the payment banner, there is further content starting with the heading **"THIS MONTH"**.
